candidate.module_doc:
W143 (EXPERIMENTAL, opt-in, scratch only): DECOUPLED camera orientation / translation observability / 6DoF availability.

Builds on, and never modifies, W142 (``app.experimental_background_rotation``: SIFT, matching, rotation-only RANSAC,
homography / essential / GRIC, rotation averaging, regimes) and W140 (``app.experimental_camera_pose``: conventions).
NOT integrated into Production, FramePose, MotionGraph, the S1 calibration, root motion or the Generator.

W142 coupled four questions into one GRIC decision.  W143 answers them separately, per edge (frame pair):
  1. GEOMETRIC MODEL FIT        which of rotation-only / homography / essential explains the matches best (W142 GRIC, kept
                                only as a descriptive label);
  2. ROTATION MEASUREMENT       is the rotation-only estimate a valid ORIENTATION measurement?  Decided from image evidence
                                independent of (1): rotation support of the background consensus set, its rotational
                                residual, agreement with the rotation implied by the homography, and multi-span cycle
                                consistency.  Its translation-induced bias is bounded by residual / f and reported;
  3. TRANSLATION OBSERVABILITY  direction only, and only when the essential model wins, decomposes with cheirality, the
                                rotation-compensated parallax is >= PARALLAX_MIN_PX and another span from the same frame
                                confirms the direction.  A homography preference alone never implies translation;
  4. FULL 6DoF AVAILABILITY     only from a frozen SfM reconstruction whose own quality evidence passes (model coverage,
                                landmarks, reprojection; per-frame observed landmarks).  Never from a translation label.

Conventions (W140/W142): optical OpenCV axes, R_WC, scalar-last quaternions; per-edge M_ij = R_CjCi; W143 orientation is
expressed in the optical frame of its reference camera; an SfM 6DoF pose is expressed in that SfM model's own gauge with
SCALE_AMBIGUOUS translation.  The two gauges are never mixed into one trajectory.

States
  orientation   ORIENTATION_ESTIMATED | ORIENTATION_UNSUPPORTED
  translation   TRANSLATION_ESTIMATED_SCALE_AMBIGUOUS (SfM only) | TRANSLATION_DIRECTION_ONLY | TRANSLATION_UNRESOLVED |
                TRANSLATION_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE      (value null unless SCALE_AMBIGUOUS SfM; never a measured zero)
  camera        FULL_6DOF_AVAILABLE | ORIENTATION_ONLY_AVAILABLE | CAMERA_MOTION_UNRESOLVED
candidate.w142_functions_reused_unchanged: SIFT features, mutual ratio matching, spans, rotation-only RANSAC + Kabsch, homography, essential + refinement, GRIC, robust chordal rotation averaging, +-0.5 s windows

datasets.held_out: sitting_static: never used for design; GT read only after freezing
datasets.known: walking_static (W141 inputs/masks); W142 outcomes already known -> not evidence of generalisation
datasets.synthetic: W142 A1-A3 renders and RGB masks, W141 A4

evaluation.edge_accounting: W143 accepted / rejected edges cross-tabulated with the W142 state of the same pair; relative-rotation error vs GT per category; bias-indicator calibration (fraction of accepted edges with GT error <= indicator + 0.05 deg)
evaluation.gt_association: real: W141 rule incl. duplicate-timestamp removal; synthetic: exact timestamp match
evaluation.orientation: W142 protocol unchanged: one evaluation-only chordal rotation alignment over the condition's valid associated frames; relative consecutive and ~1 s errors without alignment; constant-camera baseline on the same frames; coverage over all selected frames
evaluation.translation: edge direction claims vs GT direction; frames with TRANSLATION_DIRECTION_ONLY vs GT window displacement; no pseudo-ATE
evaluation.w142_comparison: W142 (historical; frozen run on sitting_static) vs W143 on the common valid frames, each re-aligned there

gates.classification: SUPPORTED: all four gates pass. NOT_YET_SUPPORTED: walking_static and sitting_static both fail AND W143 walking_static coverage gain over W142 < 0.2 (or accuracy deteriorates). PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED otherwise. BLOCKED: prerequisite failure. S1 reported, not gated.
gates.sitting_static (held-out): coverage >= 0.8; aligned median < 3.0; IF GT rotation range on valid frames >= 1.0 deg then aligned and 1 s medians below the constant baseline; frames with TRANSLATION_DIRECTION_ONLY whose GT +-0.5 s displacement < 0.01 m <= 0.1 of frames; no numeric translation without valid SfM
gates.synthetic: A1: coverage >= 0.8, max aligned < 0.5 deg; A2: coverage, median < 1.0; A1/A2 DIRECTION_OBSERVED edge fraction <= 0.01; A3: coverage, median < 1.0, direction claims (if any) median error < 30.0 deg; A4: coverage, median < 1.0, frames 20-69 TRANSLATION_DIRECTION_ONLY >= 0.5; no numeric translation without valid SfM; 0 keypoints on excluded pixels
gates.walking_static: coverage >= 0.8; aligned median < 3.0; aligned median and 1 s relative median below the constant baseline; W143 median on W142-common frames <= W142 + 0.25 deg; no numeric translation without valid SfM
gates.walking_xyz: FULL_6DOF_AVAILABLE >= 0.95 of frames; NEAR_STATIC frames <= 0.2; 0 SfM-valid frames downgraded

sitting_static.mechanism: frozen W141 segmentation (Mask R-CNN COCO_V1, score>=0.5, mask>=0.5) + 15 px disk dilation

mechanism_findings_used_for_design: synthetic correspondences: GRIC prefers a homography over pure rotation under residual radial distortion, rolling shutter and planar translation, while intrinsic errors of 1-2 % / 5 px did not flip it; under distortion the rotation-only estimate stays accurate (0.04 deg) -> homography preference alone does not make a rotation measurement unusable

the W142 cheirality failures at millimetre baselines are genuine essential-decomposition ill-conditioning (2-6 points in front at 5-10 mm; recoverPose distance cut-off ruled out); essential-derived rotation is therefore not used for orientation in W143

translation of 10-30 mm at 1-5 m depth biases the rotation-only estimate by 0.16-0.42 deg and is rejected by the support / residual criteria; 2 mm is accepted with 0.04 deg error; planar 30 mm translation is rejected (residual) although its bias indicator (0.17 deg) under-states its error (0.52 deg): the indicator is not a guaranteed bound

GT-free W142 walking_static statistics: 71 % of W142 'planar-ambiguous' edges and 92 % of rotation-only edges pass the support and residual criteria (W142 did not store the homography-agreement or cycle quantities)
pre_declaration_disclosures: Cycle validation design change from a synthetic unit test (no data output): naive median triangle scoring also rejected innocent partners of one corrupted edge, so cycle validation became greedy worst-first removal with a tie-break preferring the edge with more triangle evidence.

Phase 1 mechanism script (synthetic correspondences + GT-free historical W142 statistics) was run before this declaration; its output is bound by SHA-256. No W143 estimator was run on any real or synthetic image set before this declaration.

The known-case (walking_static) W142 GT outcomes, including the POST-HOC forced rotation-only result, were known when the thresholds were chosen; thresholds were set from the RANSAC threshold (1.5 px), a majority-support rule (0.8) and synthetic controls, not by searching on walking_static GT. The held-out sitting_static frames, masks and GT were not inspected (GT hashed only).
relationship_to_w142_posthoc: The W142 POST-HOC forced rotation-only diagnostic (all rotation-only edges with >= 30 inliers, no validation) is NOT a validated method and is not the W143 candidate. W143 accepts a rotation-only measurement only if it passes support, consensus-residual, homography-agreement and cycle checks, and reports a residual-based bias indicator; translation and 6DoF decisions are separate

sitting_static.authentication: official HTTPS URL; byte size equals the server Content-Length; downloaded SHA-256 recorded as identity
